subject: Staged capacity + co-terming approach & invoice timing
messages:
From: Amelie Dupont <amelie@finosys.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@finosys.com>; Dan Lee <dan.lee@cloudops.io>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal timing and staged capacity request

Sean — thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Quick recap from our side and a couple asks so we can get procurement moving: 

- Finosys wants to align the renewal to our fiscal year (co-term to 2027-01-01).
- We will start at a conservative capacity footprint for Q1 (roughly 50k calls/mo) and ramp to target (200k calls/mo) by Q4.
- Procurement needs an invoice schedule and a single SOW amendment that covers the staged ramp and pricing bands.

Can you confirm if Redwood can:
1) Offer a co-term that shortens/extends the existing term with pro-rated proration?
2) Support an initial lower capacity with scheduled tier increases and banded pricing (we can accept a multi-year commitment if discounts apply)?
3) Provide a proforma invoice now and a single DocuSign amendment we can sign to lock both co-term and ramp schedule?

Appreciate a timeline — procurement wants to finalize by mid-November.

Thanks,
Amelie
Head of Platform Ops
Finosys
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amelie Dupont <amelie@finosys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timing and staged capacity request

Amelie — thanks, that’s clear and totally doable in principle. High-level responses below; I’ll attach a draft amendment and provisional ramp schedule for your review.

1) Co-term: Yes. We can co-term to 2027-01-01. Our standard approach is a pro-rated charge for the shortened/extended period applied as a one-time adjustment on the first invoice after signing.

2) Staged capacity & banded pricing: We can set a staged ramp in the SOW with pre-agreed unit price bands for each tier (Q1–Q4). If you’re open to a 24-month committed term we can offer a stepped discount (higher commitment → deeper discounts). If you prefer a 12-month term we’ll still support staged ramps but with slightly smaller discounts.

3) Docs & invoicing: I’ll send a draft SOW amendment and a proforma invoice today. We can route the amendment through DocuSign and set billing milestones (invoice on signature + quarterly invoices aligning to ramp start dates).

I’ve looped in Monica for the billing cadence and Karthik to confirm discount math for the multi-year option. Proposed next steps: I’ll drop the documents today; can we target procurement sign-off by 2026-11-16?

Best,
Sean
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Amelie Dupont <amelie@finosys.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Draft proforma + billing cadence

Amelie — attaching the proforma and a suggested billing cadence:

- One-time co-term/proration adjustment due upon signature (covers alignment to 2027-01-01).
- Quarterly invoices at the start of each quarter, each invoice reflecting the billed capacity for that quarter’s starting tier.
- If capacity increases mid-quarter, we’ll issue an adjustment invoice at the quarter boundary.

Attachment stubs: SOW_Finosys_Renewal_Draft_v3.pdf (PDF), Ramp_Schedule_Finosys_Q1-Q4_2027.xlsx (XLSX), Proforma_Invoice_Q1-2027.pdf (PDF)

If you’d like, we can also send a single annual invoice option (applies if you sign up for the 24-month commit).

—Monica
Revenue Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Amelie Dupont <amelie@finosys.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@finosys.com>; Dan Lee <dan.lee@cloudops.io>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft proforma + billing cadence

Thanks — saw the attachments and reviewed with procurement. A few clarifications from our legal/procurement: 
- We prefer the multi-year (24-month) commitment if we can secure the stepped discount schedule you mentioned. Can you send a table showing per-tier unit prices under 12m vs 24m commitment?
- Co-term proration needs to be explicit in the amendment (line item with calculation).
- Procurement asks that auto-renew be disabled by default for this amendment; we’ll consider automatic renewal on mutual notice 60 days prior to term end.

If Redwood can supply the price table and the DocuSign amendment with those two clauses (explicit proration and auto-renew set to opt-in), we’re ready to proceed to signature.

Amelie
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amelie Dupont <amelie@finosys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft proforma + billing cadence

Amelie — attaching the final appendix and price table and updated SOW language per procurement’s asks. Summary of changes: 

- Price table included (12m vs 24m commitment) with stepped unit prices tied to Q1–Q4 tiers. (See Ramp_Schedule_Finosys_Q1-Q4_2027.xlsx)
- Co-term proration: explicit line item and example calculation included in Section 2 of the amendment.
- Auto-renew: set to opt-in (disabled by default); renewal only upon mutual written notice 60 days prior.
- Billing: one-time co-term adjustment billed on signature; then quarterly invoices at quarter start. Annual prepayment option present if you choose 24-month commit.

Attachment stubs: SOW_Finosys_Renewal_Draft_v3.pdf (PDF), Ramp_Schedule_Finosys_Q1-Q4_2027.xlsx (XLSX), Proforma_Invoice_Q1-2027.pdf (PDF)
